Pierogi Ruskie aka Ruthenian Dumplings from Poland, made with potato and quark.

Potato peel recipe: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x_e4kCtJIHA
🍳 My COOKING channel: https://www.youtube.com/@LifeofBorisCooking
🎮 My GAMING channel: https://www.youtube.com/@LifeofBorisGaming

📖 Buy my storybook: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D9QTB6BS

Music at start: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5WPtSR-Ck0

Recipe:
DOUGH INGREDIENTS:
250g wheat flour
150g hot water
20g melted butter
half teaspoon salt
FILLING INGREDIENTS:
500g boiled mashed potato
1 medium onion, diced, fried in oil
120g quark
salt, pepper
(also some melted butter for topping)

NOTE: makes about 50 pierogi

#pierogi #polishfood #slavcuisine
